github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Describe the staged changes, not unrelated changes. Follow the applicable repository commitlint rules. Write one Conventional Commit header. Choose the type from the effect on users, and use `feat` and `fix` only for changes that users can see. Use a scope only when one noun names the affected area. Never invent a scope or use a file path as a scope. Write the description in Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100) with only necessary articles. Keep the exact case of identifiers, and do not repeat the type as the verb. Name the effect, not the implementation. Keep the header at 72 characters or fewer, with no `(#123)` suffix. Mark a breaking change with `!` before the colon. Do not add a body, footer, attribution, or trailer, such as `Co-authored-by`, because the diff cannot show the reason for a change.
